meta.name: scripting-automation
meta.description: Use for Bash, Python, PowerShell, operational tooling, CLI helpers, migration scripts, diagnostics, glue logic, safe automation, argument parsing, idempotency, dry-run modes, retries, timeouts, and error handling.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让重复操作变成安全自动的脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常常需要写脚本来完成系统维护和迁移
copy.tagline_en: Turn repetitive tasks into safe automated scripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to write scripts for system maintenance and migration

howto.what: Claude 会编写带输入校验、重试、超时、幂等处理的操作脚本(Bash/Python/PowerShell),提供 dry-run 或确认标志避免破坏性操作,输出用法示例、验证命令、风险和假设。编写前会查外部文档并记录决策。
howto.when: 当任务涉及编写或修改 Bash、Python、PowerShell 等操作脚本,或处理命令行工具、迁移、诊断等自动化需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我写个 Bash 脚本,备份目录到远程,带重试和超时。
say.note: Claude 会先读工作流文档,再给出脚本和验证命令。

say.text: 给现有 Python 脚本加 dry-run 和输入校验,确保可重复运行。
say.note: 脚本会带防误操作标志和幂等处理。

say.text: 写一个 PowerShell 批量重命名脚本,先演练再实际执行。
say.note: 会包含确认机制,并提示风险。

howto.what_en: Claude writes operational scripts (Bash/Python/PowerShell) with validation, retries, timeouts, idempotency, and dry-run/confirmation flags. Outputs usage examples, validation commands, risks. Checks docs and records decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when writing or modifying Bash/Python/PowerShell scripts, or handling CLI tools, migrations, diagnostics, or similar automation.

say_en.text: Write a Bash script to back up a directory remotely, with retries and timeouts.
say_en.note: Reads workflow doc, outputs script and validation commands.

say_en.text: Add dry-run and validation to this Python script so it can rerun safely.
say_en.note: The script will include anti-mistake flags and idempotency.

say_en.text: Write a PowerShell script to rename files in bulk, dry-run first then execute.
say_en.note: Will include a confirmation mechanism and point out risks.
